ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump administration's hold on Medicaid funding.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the hold on Medicaid funding affect Minnesota's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and impact the lives of many people in Minnesota. I will use public records to investigate the allegations and determine the extent of the fraud.

ideas.title: The FBI's Investigation into Kash Patel
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's investigation into Kash Patel and his involvement in the Mar-a-Lago investigation.
questions: What is the nature of the FBI's investigation into Kash Patel?
What are the implications of the investigation for the Mar-a-Lago case?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a significant investigation and its implications for the Mar-a-Lago case. I will use data analysis to investigate the allegations and determine the extent of Kash Patel's involvement.
